text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.ssh","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"source_address_prefix","title":"The inbound SSH rule allows port 22 from \"0.0.0.0/1\", which is a public range wide enough to count as the internet and exposes admin access.","suggestion":"Restrict the source to a private range, a bastion host, or another approved non-internet address range.","breaks_standard":true}]}
